questions.q: Many a ___ tried to reach the summit and failed.
questions.why: *many a* + однина + однинне дієслово: *Many a climber has*. *climbers have* — множина після *many a*; *climber have* і *climbers has* — неузгоджені.

questions.q: Your essay is excellent, apart from the ___ spelling mistake.
There were thirty-___ people at the meeting.
She gave the children what ___ money she had left.
questions.why: «Те небагато, що» з нелічильним — *what little money*. *what few* — для множини; *what a little* і *what less* — неграматично.

questions.q: We packed what ___ clothes we could carry and left.
questions.why: З множиною — *what few clothes*. *what little* — для нелічильних; *what a few* і *what fewer* — неграматично.

questions.q: The ___ people who came to the concert loved it.
questions.why: «Ті нечисленні, хто» — *The few people who*. *The little* — для нелічильних; *The a few of* — неграматично; *The less* — неграматично.

questions.q: I've told you ___ times to switch off the light!
questions.why: Розмовне «безліч разів» — *umpteen times*. *umpteenth* — порядковий («у сто перший раз»), потребує *the*; інші варіанти неграматичні.

questions.q: Only a ___ of people turned up to the meeting.
questions.why: «Жменька, кілька» — *a handful of*. *a hand of*, *handfull*, *hands* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: Good restaurants are few and far ___ in this area.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *few and far between*. *among*, *away*, *apart* у ньому не вживають.

questions.q: ___ one of you has helped make this a success.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *Each and every one of you*. Інші поєднання неправильні.

questions.q: I've been to that museum a good ___ times.
questions.why: «Чимало разів» — *a good few times*. *a good little* — неграматично; *a good deal* — з нелічильними; *a good much* — неграматично.

questions.q: Don't worry about the paper — just use ___ old box.
questions.why: Розмовне «будь-який, абияк» — *any old box*. *some old box* — «якась стара коробка» (інший зміст); *every* і *each* — неграматично тут.

questions.q: Many a ___ (student) has failed this exam.
He spent what ___ time he had with his family.
The essay is fine except for the ___ error.
There were fifty-___ guests at the wedding.
